term: Grounding necessity in the selected source readings
definition: Trogdon distinguishes persistence of the grounding claim, necessary existence of some grounded fact, and entailment of grounded truth by full grounds; his target is the third. Leuenberger distinguishes Entailment from Internality and proposes whole-fact-base supervenience. Richardson distinguishes essential real-definition what-grounding from contrastive difference-making why-grounding. None of these source readings is identical by definition to existential support or a common well-founded rank.
note: Exact pinned locators and source/type boundaries are in docs/notes/modal-grounding-priority-950.md; source statements are prose-only. This is an analyst vocabulary audit; the linked primary claims source its component readings, not an identity across their frameworks.
